content: समुत्थानम् .²1 Rising, getting up. .²2 Resurrection. .²3 Perfect cure, complete recovery. .²4 Healing (as of a wound); समुत्थानव्ययं दाप्यः <ls>Ms. 8. 287</ls>; <ls>Y. 2. 222</ls>. .²5 A symptom of disease. .²6 Engaging in industry, active occupation; as in संभूयसमुत्थानम् <ls>Ms. 8. 4</ls>. .²7 Increase or growth. .²8 Industry; यज्ञो विद्या समुत्थानम् <ls>Mb. 12. 23. 10</ls>. .²9 Hoisting (of a flag). .²10 Swelling (of the abdomen).
